question: Should Kotlin 2.4.10 be accepted for Android once every required check and focused Android build validation is green on the final Dependabot head?
rationale: The patch is structurally correct, but accepting a compiler update with documented Compose inference changes is a release-risk choice that generic checks alone cannot settle.

options.title: Validate final head and merge
options.body: Wait for the rebase to settle, require exact-head Android build, test, lint, and benchmark compilation, then merge if all evidence is green.

options.title: Hold Kotlin 2.4.0
options.body: Close or defer the update if the final matrix exposes build, code-generation, recomposition, or release-smoke regressions.

recommendation.title: Validate final head and merge
recommendation.body: Wait for the rebase to settle, require exact-head Android build, test, lint, and benchmark compilation, then merge if all evidence is green.
